instruction: Open the music video on the desktop with VLC and convert it to MP3 format. Save the audio file as "Baby Justin Bieber.mp3" on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening video in VLC and converting to MP3 format. Evaluator uses file command to verify the output is a valid MP3/MPEG audio file format.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator checks all three requirements - (1) file exists at specified path, (2) filename matches 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp3', (3) file is MP3 format
Correct logical flow: Metric checks existence first, then filename, then format - returns 0.0 if any check fails, 1.0 only if all pass
Semantic correctness: Getter extracts exactly the right state using bash file test and file command to detect MP3 format
Proper parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('is_mp3') when expected.type='rule' (framework returns rules dict directly)
Good edge case handling: Distinguishes between file not found vs wrong filename vs wrong format with appropriate logging
Data flow correctness: Getter returns comprehensive dict with all needed fields, metric validates all aspects sequentially
